description: Call this tool to write one stored invoice as an A4 PDF and return the path: issuer, BILL TO, dates, items, taxes and totals. Free stamps a credit line and no logo; Pro renders it unbranded with your logo.

number.description: Invoice number to render, as returned by invoice_create

out_path.description: Where to write the PDF; defaults to <data dir>/pdf/<number>.pdf. The page carries the issuer block, the BILL TO client block, dates, an item table with wrapped descriptions, subtotal, discount, one tax line per rate, the total, payment details and notes, and every money value on it carries its currency code. Use a .pdf path: the bytes written are always PDF

name: invoice_pdf
title: Render invoice PDF
